caption:
Your email to HR gets ignored because it sounds like every other email.

Give AI the details: who you are writing to, the exact role, your one best project, and a word limit.

Write a 90 word email to [name], HR at [company], for the [role] internship. Mention my [project]. Friendly, no esteemed.

Always edit it to sound like you before sending. Send this to a friend applying this week.
